item.title: SparkFun Officially Dropping AdaFruit due to CoC Violation
item.description:
📝 Please see the official communication we sent to Adafruit below. Without oversharing, recent violations include: Sending and forwarding offensive, antagonistic, and derogatory emails and material to SparkFun employees, former employees and customers Inappropriately involving a SparkFun customer with a private matter We understand this may be frustrating. Please see our distributor map below.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sparkfun.com/official-response

item.title: Why NUKEMAP isn't on Google Maps anymore (2019)
item.description:
📝 At right, the remade original NUKEMAP from 2012, which used the Google Maps API/Javascript. And from 2012 through 2016, Google didn’t charge a thing for this. I reached out to Google to find out why this was.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.nuclearsecrecy.com/2019/12/13/why-nukemap-isnt-on-google-maps-anymore/

item.title: Never-before-seen Linux malware is "more advanced than typical"
item.description:
📝 Symbols and comments within the source code suggest that VoidLink remains under development. Rootkit functions that allow VoidLink to blend in with normal system activity. VoidLink still indicates defenders should apply vigilance when working with Linux machines.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/01/never-before-seen-linux-malware-is-far-more-advanced-than-typical/
